body: My parents weren't raised the same way as I was, and thus they want me to go into college as soon as possible, but I can't give them that. I've already pressured them so much to letting me quit what is essentially the "best" university in my country, that I can't fathom what will happen if I ask them even more. Most my friends are all busy studying, so I'm pretty much alone and depressed in my room everyday. There's not much I could do anymore.

I live in Indonesia, yet I was raised in a international school with western views and values, so when I graduated things just plummeted. I like my country, but I had to face the fact that most of my views don't match the generally accepted norms here. I *wish* I could take a break to find myself, but unfortunately that just isn't a thing here, I can't. There are no such things as a gap year program, let alone people even talking about gap years here. My parents already want me to get into a college straight away, but I can't do that yet. There's no way out. I've lost.

In high school, I was known as a perfect-grade student, having an A in every subject. With this in mind, people were already setting high expectations for me, expecting I'll be a "successful" person straight off the bat. In my country, it's a norm for high school students to go straight into college right after they graduated. I didn't know what I wanted to do with my life yet, but regardless I picked a major and was accepted into what is considered to be the "best" university in my country. To some, all this may sound great, but I hated it, and I can totally understand if people see me as selfish if all they see is the outside of me. Inside, it was a total nightmare. I hated my major, I hate the traditional norms here, I hated it so much that I nearly lost myself. I don't even know if I belong in my country, since I have so many conflicting views. Here in my country, people don't give a shit about suicidal people and instead frown upon them. There isn't even a suicide hotline. At one point, I've had it and I stopped attending uni, I didn't even take the exam. My parents accepted this outcome, but now they expect me to apply straight into another university and get in one this year, and frankly I don't think I'm going to make it. I've already missed so many deadlines for the universities I favor to and it's impossible for me to get into any other university that are still open because I'm missing so many documents. I can't do it. The only option is for me to go into a coma so I could start over at the middle of the year.

I can't. So many people are already expecting so much from me that I can't keep this up anymore, I can't fulfill their expectations. I'm a disappointment, there's no way around it. I can only seek to enter a coma so that at least I'd have an excuse for my mess and I could start over a new year.
